h: Eric Bauza, the voice of Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, dies at 46
p: The Emmy-winning voice actor, best known for voicing Looney Tunes characters such as Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, has died at the age of 46, according to reports. Tributes from fans and colleagues are circulating online.
more: He took over several classic Looney Tunes roles in recent years.
Fans are sharing clips of his best-loved performances.
